# Reference Gear ratios by tire size (General)

> Items marked **[Partial]** are only partly confirmed by the source and need more work. They stay in the review queue and are firmed up, corrected or removed as more sources come in.

## Summary

[Partial] Check the door jamb sticker to identify if you have 4.90 gears or 4.63 gears. [t2183]

Note that 31-inch tires were previously run before upgrading to 33s. [t1424]

## Procedure

> **[Partial]** Needs more work: the verifier could confirm only part of this procedure (the steps marked [Partial], or whether the list is complete). Steps or precautions may be wrong or missing; read the source thread before relying on it. Later runs fill it in as more sources are found.

1. [Partial] Check the door jamb sticker on the driver's side for the HG[num] code.
2. [Partial] Identify if you have 4.90 gears (HG49) or 4.63 gears (HG46).
3. Determine that running larger tires requires numerically higher gearing to maintain power.

_Procedure reported by [t2183]._

## Specifications

- **Stock gear ratio for XE I4 engine**: 4.875 [t2183] ([Unverified] single report)
- **Stock gear ratio for XE V6 with Limited Slip/Off-Road package**: 4.90 [t2183] ([Partial] [Unverified] single report)
- **Stock gear ratio for XE V6 with standard setup**: 4.63 [t2183] ([Partial] [Unverified] single report)

## Tips & gotchas

- A sticker on the door panel or under the hood indicates the ratio. [t2183]
- The transfer case gears are independent and do not need to match the diffs. [t2183]
